verdicts.evidence: A synthetic geometry check recovered latent trajectories with max error 6.90e-06 and reprojection error 3.74e-06, but this was on synthetic data only; the official package cannot import due to missing lvcg.data modules, so no real ECG/VCG inversion was executed.

The logbook confirms the paper describes three objective terms, but training cannot import (ModuleNotFoundError), the released code adds a unit-weight base-beat loss absent from Equation 7, and a post-paper GRU shape fix was needed; no training was executed to verify the objective.

Released splits are disjoint and Table-1 averages are arithmetically consistent (67.30 vs printed 67.3), but no checkpoints or result files are released, the checkpoint override is ineffective, and PTB-XL Sub-Class label ordering differs between train and val/test; the actual AUC numbers cannot be reproduced.
The repository contains no checkpoints, reconstruction predictions, per-lead outputs, or metric files; Table 2 MSE/MAE numbers cannot be regenerated.
No ablation configs, checkpoints, seeds, or outputs are released; the ablation table is display-only and cannot be reproduced.

The paper evaluates MIMIC-IV-ECG-Ext-ICD but the repository supplies an AI-READI provider instead, with no paper-dataset loader, folds, labels, checkpoint, or outputs; neither the CKD AUC nor the temporal-module ablation can be reproduced.

overall: The logbook establishes only that the VCG geometry equation is numerically coherent on synthetic data and that the released data splits are disjoint with arithmetically consistent Table-1 averages. No empirical results table can be reproduced because no checkpoints, result files, or runnable training/evaluation pipelines are available, and several paper-code mismatches (extra loss term, wrong non-cardiac dataset, label-ordering discrepancy) further block reproduction.
